steps.text: write the acceptance's test through the outside seam (the MCP endpoint, the signed routes, a real client), never an internal function or a table read
run it before the fix and keep the failing output as proof/<slice>/<nn>-red-<acceptance>.log
make it pass and keep the output as proof/<slice>/<nn>-green-<acceptance>.log
link both from the acceptance table in proof/<slice>/README.md; a guard that was green from the start says so instead of claiming a red
keep a mistaken test, fixture or verifier as its own authoring-error log, never as red evidence

pitfalls: a fixture padded to 8,000,005 bytes was rejected as over the limit; it was kept as an authoring-error log so it could not pass for a red run (82619fe)
shared-pipeline guards were already green after the first implementation; the table says so rather than claiming a failing history (82619fe)
binding: none: this session owns no active work order
